154: def create_stores():
155:     """
156:     Registers all store modules and all schemes
157:     from the given config. Duplicates are not re-registered.
158:     """
159:     store_count = 0
160:     store_classes = set()
161:     for store_entry in CONF.known_stores:
162:         store_entry = store_entry.strip()
163:         if not store_entry:
164:             continue
165:         store_cls = _get_store_class(store_entry)
166:         store_instance = store_cls()
167:         schemes = store_instance.get_schemes()
168:         if not schemes:
169:             raise BackendException('Unable to register store %s. '
170:                                    'No schemes associated with it.'
171:                                    % store_cls)
172:         else:
173:             if store_cls not in store_classes:
174:                 LOG.debug("Registering store %s with schemes %s",
175:                           store_cls, schemes)
176:                 store_classes.add(store_cls)
177:                 scheme_map = {}
178:                 for scheme in schemes:
179:                     loc_cls = store_instance.get_store_location_class()
180:                     scheme_map[scheme] = {
181:                         'store_class': store_cls,
182:                         'location_class': loc_cls,
183:                     }
184:                 location.register_scheme_map(scheme_map)
185:                 store_count += 1
186:             else:
187:                 LOG.debug("Store %s already registered", store_cls)
188:     return store_count
